Password Policy

Rules for new passwords, enforced by the server on every app, TV and Quick Connect. Nothing applies until you assign a profile, and a new password is only required when you ask for one.

keyTemporary password creates a random password, shows it to you once and signs the user out everywhere. The user signs in with it and must then choose their own. Use it for forgotten passwords and for accounts without a password, which stay locked until they get one.

expand_moreWhat the Password column means

The plugin never stores passwords and never judges a stored password after the fact; Jellyfin itself only keeps a hash. A password is checked only at the moment it is set. After that the plugin only remembers which rules it was checked against. That is why passwords set before then honestly show "Unknown".

timer

Time to set it

Preselected for every new request, from a user's row or from the buttons below; you can change it in each request. Requests already running keep their deadline.

Right away signs people out after the grace period. With days, they keep full access and get reminders until the deadline.

lockAccounts without any password never get a notice period: once they have a profile or a request, they are locked right away on every app, TV and Quick Connect, and only a temporary password from you unlocks them. Nobody can claim such an account by just knowing its name.

group

Ask several users at once

Your own account is never included. You see exactly who is affected, and pick the time to set it, before anything happens.

What users see

With the saved time to set it. The TV message uses your message text from More settings.

link

Link for TVs and apps

TVs cannot show the change dialog. Those users set their password through this link, for example on their phone, and then sign in as usual.

Message for users

A short text with the link and the deadline from "Time to set it", for a chat or an email.

In a browser and in the Jellyfin apps for Android, iOS and desktop, users get a popup they have to answer, and the change dialog right at sign-in. TVs and other apps show Jellyfin's own message window while the user still has access (during a notice period), and after that only "sign-in failed". Pick a notice period so their apps warn them first, or send them the message yourself.

tune

Profile for all users

Applies to everyone set to "Same as all users" and to every new account. A stricter profile never signs anyone out: passwords checked earlier show "Older rules".

    infoEverything here only applies to users with a profile unless stated otherwise.

    group

    Who and when

    Counted from the last change. For passwords set earlier, from the day the plugin first saw the user sign in. 0 = never.
    days

    Users with a profile always replace a password you gave them (at creation or later) at their first sign-in. With this option, users without a profile do too. Accounts created without any password stay locked until you give them a temporary password.
    When creating users and when you set another user's password. Either way the user replaces that password with their own at the next sign-in.
    Administrator accounts then have no profile and no expiry. An explicit request for a new password still applies. Turning it off asks first if it would lock an administrator account without a password.
    Checklist and strength meter when changing your own password and when creating users.
    notifications

    Messages and sign-out

    When a new password is required, every open session gets a message; sign-out happens after the grace period.
    When a new password is required right away. 0 to 300 seconds.
